title: Homo- and Heterovalent Polynuclear Cerium and Cerium/Manganese Aggregates

material_class.structural_family: hollow octahedral {CeIV6(μ3-O)8} core without interstitial μ6-oxo

synthesis.procedure: All reactions under aerobic conditions. Method A: To a stirred solution of [Cu2(μ-H2O)(O2CtBu)4(tBuCO2H)]·2H2O (0.21 g, 0.21 mmol) and Ce(NO3)3·6H2O (0.08 g, 0.21 mmol) in MeCN (10 ml) was gradually added a solution of 2,2'-iminobis[ethanol] (H2dea) (0.13 g, 1.26 mmol) in MeCN (5 ml). The solution was heated under reflux for 40 min, cooled, filtered, and left to evaporate slowly. After two weeks, light green crystals were collected, washed with MeCN, and dried in air (13% based on Ce). Method B: Propane-1,3-diol (4 mmol, 0.30 g) in MeCN (5 ml) and Ce(NO3)3·6H2O (0.6 mmol, 0.26 g) were added to a stirred solution of [Mn(OAc)2]·4H2O (0.15 g, 0.6 mmol) and pivalic acid (0.20 g, 2.0 mmol) in MeCN (10 ml). The solution was stirred for 1 h, cooled, filtered, and left to evaporate slowly at r.t. Very light brown crystals after 2 d were washed with MeCN and dried in air (22% based on Ce).

reagents.name: cerium(III) nitrate hexahydrate
reagents.amount: 0.08 g, 0.21 mmol (Method A); 0.6 mmol, 0.26 g (Method B)

synthesis.time: reflux 40 min, then 2 weeks crystallization (A); stir 1 h, crystals after 2 d (B)
synthesis.vessel_or_method: aerobic solution reaction with slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filter, slow evaporation; crystals washed with MeCN and dried in air
synthesis.yield: 13% based on Ce (Method A); 22% based on Ce (Method B)

source_locations.location: Experimental Part, compound 1 Methods A and B

material_class.structural_family: octahedral {CeIV6(μ3-O)8} core with four additional MnIII centers on μ4-oxo sites

synthesis.procedure: To a stirred solution of [Mn(OAc)2]·4H2O (0.24 g, 1.00 mmol), Ce(NO3)3·6H2O (0.40 g, 1.00 mmol), and pivalic acid (0.50 g, 5.00 mmol) in MeCN (20 ml) was gradually added a solution of Hedte (0.24 g, 1.00 mmol) in MeCN (5 ml). The solution was heated under reflux for 20 min, cooled, filtered, and allowed to evaporate slowly. After 1 d, light brown crystals were collected, washed with MeCN, and dried in air.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: aerobic reflux in MeCN, slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filter, slow evaporation; light brown crystals washed with MeCN and dried in air

material_class.structural_family: ionic crystal containing {Ce6Mn8} cations based on an octahedral {CeIV6O8} core plus a hexanuclear CeIV anion and a mononuclear CeIII complex

synthesis.procedure: To a stirred slurry of [Mn6O2(O2CtBu)10(4-Me-py)2.5(tBuCO2H)1.5] (0.20 g, 0.11 mmol) and pyridine-2-ethanol (Hpye; 0.22 g, 1.80 mmol) in MeCN (15 ml) was added Ce(NO3)3·6H2O (0.34 g, 0.88 mmol). The mixture was stirred for 30 min at r.t. and then heated at 65 °C for 20 min. The brown solution was filtered and left undisturbed. After 2 d, crystals were collected, washed with cold MeCN (5 ml), and dried in air.
synthesis.time: stir 30 min at r.t., heat 20 min; crystals after 2 d
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filter and leave undisturbed; crystals washed with cold MeCN and dried in air

material_class.structural_family: octahedral {CeIV6O8} core with additional CeIII and MnIII centers

synthesis.procedure: Method A: To a stirred slurry of [Mn(OAc)2]·4H2O (0.025 g, 0.1 mmol), pivalic acid (0.071 g, 0.7 mmol), and Ce(NO3)3·6H2O (0.35 g, 0.8 mmol) in MeCN was added dropwise a solution of H2tbdea (0.32 g, 2 mmol) in MeCN (5 ml). The dark brown solution was stirred at r.t. for 2 h and filtered. The precipitate was dissolved in CH2Cl2 (5 ml) and combined with the filtrate, then allowed to evaporate slowly at r.t. Brown plates formed after 48 h, washed with MeCN, and dried in air (28% based on Mn). Method B: as Method A but with (NH4)2[CeIV(NO3)6] (0.44 g, 0.8 mmol) as Ce source; filtrate evaporated slowly at r.t. gave brown plates of an isomorphous MeCN solvate after 24 h.
synthesis.time: stir 2 h; crystals after 48 h (A) or 24 h (B)
synthesis.vessel_or_method: aerobic slurry in MeCN; CH2Cl2 used to redissolve precipitate in Method A
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filter; precipitate dissolved in CH2Cl2 and combined with filtrate; slow evaporation yields brown plates washed with MeCN

source_locations.location: Experimental Part, compound 4 Methods A and B

material_class.structural_family: compact mixed-valent CeIV/CeIII core with a peripheral MnIII center

synthesis.procedure: Method A: To a stirred slurry of [Mn(OAc)2]·4H2O (0.025 g, 0.1 mmol), [Fe3O(tBuCO2)6]O2CtBu (0.7 g, 0.7 mmol), and Ce(NO3)3·6H2O (0.35 g, 0.8 mmol) in MeCN was added dropwise H2bdea (0.32 g, 2 mmol) in MeCN (5 ml). The dark brown solution was stirred at r.t. for 2 h, filtered, and evaporated slowly. Orange triangular blocks after one week (32% based on Mn). Method B: To a stirred slurry of [Mn(OAc)2]·4H2O (0.025 g, 0.1 mmol), pivalic acid (0.071 g, 0.7 mmol), and Ce(NO3)3·6H2O (0.35 g, 0.8 mmol) in MeCN was added dropwise H2bdea (0.32 g, 2 mmol) in MeCN (5 ml). Stirred at r.t. 2 h, filtered, slow evaporation; orange triangular blocks after 48 h (25% based on Mn).
synthesis.time: stir 2 h; crystals after 1 week (A) or 48 h (B)
synthesis.vessel_or_method: aerobic slurry in MeCN, slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filter and evaporate slowly; orange triangular blocks
synthesis.yield: 32% based on Mn (Method A); 25% based on Mn (Method B)

source_locations.location: Experimental Part, compound 5 Methods A and B

synthesis.procedure: To a stirred slurry of [Mn(OAc)2]·4H2O (0.025 g, 0.1 mmol), pivalic acid (0.071 g, 0.7 mmol), and (NH4)2[CeIV(NO3)6] (0.44 g, 0.8 mmol) in MeCN was added dropwise a solution of H2bdea (0.32 g, 2 mmol) in MeCN (5 ml). The dark brown solution was stirred at r.t. for 2 h, filtered, and allowed to evaporate slowly. Orange triangular blocks were obtained after 48 h.

synthesis.procedure: A stirred slurry of [Mn6O2(O2CtBu)10(4-Me-py)2.5(tBuCO2H)1.5] (0.20 g, 0.11 mmol) in MeCN (10 ml) was heated to 70 °C, then (NH4)2[CeIV(NO3)6] (0.27 g, 0.50 mmol) and furoic acid (0.11 g, 1.00 mmol) were added in small portions, giving a dark-brown solution after 20 min. After stirring under reflux for an additional 30 min, the solution was filtered and concentrated by slow evaporation to give dark-brown crystals after 4 d. Crystals were collected, washed with MeCN, and dried in air. Coordinated furan is attributed to oxidative decarboxylation of furoic acid.

reagents.name: furoic acid
reagents.role: organic acid; source of coordinated furan

synthesis.time: 20 min after additions plus 30 min reflux; crystals after 4 d
synthesis.vessel_or_method: aerobic heating/reflux in MeCN, slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filter, concentrate by slow evaporation; dark-brown crystals washed with MeCN and dried in air
